cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That raffle was a fair draw. Read the result out; I taught you to announce a winner clearly, not mumble into the prize table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You folded your own ticket differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For filing. Good eye, though you used to need me to read every ticket for you. The number still won fairly; read it out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can feel which ticket is yours without looking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hands out of the bowl now. The draw's finished. Use the voice we practised and congratulate me.
